title: Show HN: RxFilm Studio–Create and edit your product videos with AI agent
snippet:
Hi HN,
I built RxFilm Studio, a video workspace that lets you create and revise videos with AI agent.
The reason I started this project is simple: I’ve noticed that many independent developers and small teams want to create marketing videos for their product, but producing these videos requires a lot of time and effort — from editing and visual effects to voiceovers and subtitles.
So I built Rxfilm Studio to simplify the entire video creation process. Start with an idea, a product website, images, or existing footage, and then generate a complete video with:
- Story and structure
- Editing and timeline
- Visual and sound effects
- Voiceovers, background music
- Subtitles and translation
Github: https://github.com/rxtech-lab/film-workflow
Here's a demo marketing video created using RxFilm Studio:
https://youtu.be/9_M15fRdZQE
Welcome to try it out and I would love to hear your feedback!
